metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Checkmate

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · Thiruchitrambalam
metas.description: Thiruchitrambalam lives with his father and grandfather. He blames the former for the loss of his mother and sister and is not on good terms with the latter. Meanwhile, his love life is not so successful.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · There's Still Tomorrow
metas.description: In this moving comedic drama set in postwar Rome, a working-class wife and mother dreams of a better future. Winner of 6 Italian Academy Awards.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · Love Today
metas.description: Two young lovers, who are made to exchange their phones for a day and what happens due to that.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2022 · Hundreds of Beavers
metas.description: In this 19th century, supernatural winter epic, a drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Dinner in America
metas.description: An on-the-lam punk rocker and a young woman obsessed with his band unexpectedly fall in love and go on an epic journey together through America's decaying Midwestern suburbs.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Tourist Family
metas.description: A quirky Sri Lankan family seeking a fresh start in India transforms a disconnected neighborhood into a vibrant community with their infectious love and kindness.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Nirvanna the Band the Show the Movie

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2022 · The First Slam Dunk
metas.description: Follows 17-year-old Ryota Miyagi, who struggles to accomplish his late elder brother's dream of becoming a basketball star.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Sarvam Maya
metas.description: A young Hindu priest's peaceful life is disrupted when he meets a spirit. What starts as a supernatural challenge evolves into a profound journey that tests his faith and makes him question everything he knows.

metas.description: In 2010, high school senior Husam, his best friend Maan, their one-time foe Ibrahim, and their teacher Orabi set out to produce a no-budget horror movie.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · John Candy: I Like Me
metas.description: Explores the life and legacy of iconic funnyman John Candy, who died of a heart attack in 1994, at age 43.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2026 · Uttar Da Puttar
metas.description: Vastu, destiny and daily life, where unexpected events challenge beliefs about luck, direction and the power to shape your own future.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Jigarthanda Double X
metas.description: In 1975, a filmmaker agrees to collaborate on a film with a gangster who wishes to become a famous actor.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Romancham
metas.description: A game of Ouija board goes hilariously wrong when seven bachelors unexpectedly invite a spirit and try to make the best out of the situation.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2021 · The Great Indian Kitchen
metas.description: After marriage, a woman struggles to be the submissive wife that her husband and his family expect her to be. The story follows her journey, as she changes herself and, even more so, changes the household.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2025 · Mission Muh Dikhayi
metas.description: Mission Muh Dikhayi follows Anjana, a modern woman who marries Devesh, an engineer from Delhi. Two days later, the Muh Dikhayi ritual ignites culture clash, emotional conflict, and a struggle between modern values and tradition.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Dulhaniya Le Aaeegi
metas.description: Navya, the only daughter of powerful businessman Devi Prasad, is set for a grand wedding that soon goes off track due to unexpected twists. As secrets unfold and egos clash, the celebration turns into a modern-day swayamvar.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
metas.description: Follows a couple with a significant age difference as they navigate their romantic relationship.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2021 · Mandela
metas.description: A local barber's fate turns overnight when he becomes the single deciding vote in the village elections.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Ante Sundharaniki
metas.description: A Hindu Brahmin falls for a Christian girl and they both lie to their parents, only for their lies to be revealed.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Ponman
metas.description: Gold dealer Ajesh lends precious sovereigns for a village wedding, but finds himself in danger when the bride's criminal husband schemes to keep the gold and silence him forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2020 · Kannum Kannum Kollaiyadithaal
metas.description: Two wily online scammers mend their fraudulent ways after meeting the girls of their dreams - until a deceitful discovery throws their world for a loop.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · Superboys of Malegaon
metas.description: The residents of Malegaon look to Bollywood cinema for a much-needed escape from daily drudgery. Amateur filmmaker Nasir Shaikh gets inspired to make a film for the people of Malegaon, by the people of Malegaon. He bands together his ragtag group of friends to bring his vision to life, thereby bringing a fresh lease of life into the town.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2024 · Lubber Pandhu
metas.description: Set against the rural backdrop, explores gully cricket stars Gethu and Anbu's intense rivalry. Anbu's romantic involvement with Gethu's daughter escalates the clash. Their skills and emotions are put to the ultimate test.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Joyland
metas.description: The youngest son in a traditional Pakistani family takes a job as a backup dancer in a Bollywood-style burlesque and quickly becomes infatuated with the strong-willed trans woman who runs the show.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2024 · Haikyu!! The Dumpster Battle
metas.description: Despite a strong field, the Karasuno High volleyball team advances past the preliminary round of the Harutaka tournament in Miyagi prefecture to reach the third round.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2024 · Ghostlight
metas.description: When a construction worker unexpectedly joins a local theater's production of Romeo and Juliet, the drama onstage starts to mirror his own life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Su from So
metas.description: In a quiet village, a boy's innocent crush unleashes strange events that have everyone convinced he's brought a ghost along with his feelings

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2022 · Jaya Jaya Jaya Jaya Hey

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · Mukundan Unni Associates

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · With Love

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2021 · The Sparks Brothers

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2022 · Nna, Thaan Case Kodu

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · The Amazing Digital Circus: The Last Act
metas.description: Feature length version of the final two episodes (episode 8 and 9) of The Amazing Digital Circus, showing the conclusion of the cast of characters trapped in a digital realm under the mercy of an unstable ringmaster.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2025 · U Are the Universe

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Stand by Me Doraemon 2
metas.description: Nobita travels to the future to show his beloved grandma his bride, but adult Nobita has fled his own wedding. Can he ever be a good husband to Shizuka?

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · A Poet

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2020 · Oh My Kadavule

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2023 · Good Night

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Don't Be Shy
metas.description: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2021 · Psych 3: This Is Gus

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2020 · Feels Good Man
metas.description: Artist Matt Furie, creator of the comic character Pepe the Frog, begins an uphill battle to take back his iconic cartoon image from those who used it for their own purposes.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2025 · The Devil
metas.description: Rajashekar (Chief Minister of Karnataka) is framed, so his secretary recruits Krishna, a kindhearted lookalike, to impersonate the violent heir Dhanush. When the real Dhanush returns, both men clash for political power and Rukmini’s love. Krishna must protect Rukmini from Dhanush while also rising as a leader the people trust.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · Writer Padmabhushan
metas.description: Padmabhushan, a 25-year-old aspiring writer based out of Vijayawada and his middle class family take us on a roller coaster ride packed with innocuous fun and soft emotions, with their heart in the right place.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2022 · Luxembourg, Luxembourg
